text:
Ana CS: Starting the bring-up window for Meridian's Dedicated capacity. Scope: validate autoscale boundaries, quota gating rules, and run a multi-model load sweep. Target: safely ramp to 55% of their reserved QPS by EOD and confirm fallbacks. Liam, can you verify reserved nodes and any placement constraints?

Liam Infra: Confirmed, cluster meridian-dedicated in us-east-1. 6x H100s reserved with `reserved=true` taint, plus 1 spare warm node. Networking ACLs set for customer CIDRs.

Priya SRE: For safety, we'll use a conservative autoscale policy first: `min_replicas=1`, `max_replicas=12`, queue_depth target 180, and a cooldown of 2m. PagerDuty escalation pinned to the meridian-onboard escalation.

Marco ML: We have 3 model variants: base, v1-quant, v1-q8. Priming strategy: short prefix warm for v1-quant then a KV-fill pass for base. I'll push priming payloads to /playbooks/meridian/warmup.json.

Ana CS: Checklist posted. Please mark off as you complete:
- infra reserved and taints set
- autoscale policy applied
- priming pushed
- smoke run executed
- soak scheduled

Devon SE: Running the smoke (command below) now, small sample run to validate auth & headers:
```
loadtest --url https://meridian.redwood/api/chat --qps 30 --concurrency 8 --duration 6m --header "X-Customer: meridian"
```
Posting logs to the playbook.

Liam Infra: Autoscale policy applied:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 12
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  metrics:
    - type: queue_depth
      target: 180
```

ops-bot: priming job meridian-priming-2026-03-21 started (job id: pjm-2244), 12 shards.

Priya SRE: Smoke results: median=145ms, p95=325ms at qps=30. No memory issues. Proceeding to ramp plan.

Ana CS: Paste ramp so customers know what to expect.

Priya SRE: Ramp plan:
- 7m @ 10% committed QPS
- 12m @ 25%
- 15m @ 40%
- 20m @ 55% target soak
- 25m steady at 55% (collecting telemetry)
Abort conditions: p95>380ms, error rate >1.5% sustained 3min.

Marco ML: Watching output quality during ramp. If v1-q8 shows regressions >3% on eval set we fallback to v1-quant.

Devon SE: First regression pass (10 prompts) returned 9/10 within acceptable bands, p95 310ms. Uploading diffs.

Liam Infra: Added a temporary circuit-breaker: if total GPU util > 88% drop new requests to fallback cluster. Also adjusted nginx keepalive from 75s->60s.

ops-bot: soak job meridian-soak-2026-03-21 queued (id: ms-7781). ETA +1h.

Priya SRE: At 40% ramp autoscale added 2 replicas. p95 335ms, error rate 0.4%. Continuing.

Ana CS: Notifying Meridian PM & SRE of start time +30m. Will set expectation for post-warmup summary.

Marco ML: KV hit-rate after priming 69% — aiming for +10% during soak. Will schedule an extended priming if not improving.

Devon SE: Running scheduled regression every 15m, attaching latest: 10/10 passed, mean latency 150ms, p95 320ms.

ops-bot: soak job ms-7781 heartbeat: 18m elapsed, progress steady, errors 0.

Priya SRE: At 55% steady for 8m now: p95 ~345ms, error rate 0.3%. Holding and monitoring.

Liam Infra: FYI I patched runtime kernel flags for improved batching (experimental) — rolled out only to meridian-dedicated pool. Revert plan ready.

Ana CS: If we remain stable for the remaining window, I'll move meridian to `onboard: ready` and schedule a KT with their team. Also logging outcome to renewal dashboard.

Marco ML: Final note — we'll produce a 1-page post-warmup summary covering latency, KV hit-rate, autoscale events, and any fallback switches.

Devon SE: soak job ms-7781 completed, duration 1h05m, errors 0. All metrics in runbook.

Ana CS: Closing thread — thanks all. Will share the one-pager in #customer-success-docs and loop in the AE for renewal touchpoint. :white_check_mark:
